> Thanks again for interviewing Ari last week. We need to close the loop on scorecards so Recruiting can move to references and an offer if we have consensus.

Attached my completed scorecard (see quick notes below). Overall strong across system design and delivery; hesitated a bit on scale patterns we use for KV cache flushes but provided reasonable tradeoffs. I scored 4/5 on technical, 4/5 on product sense, 3/5 on leadership — gave a soft no if leadership is mandatory for this role, otherwise a green.

Quick notes:
- Tech: solid decomposition of problem, good latency-aware choices.
- Prod sense: prioritized operational considerations; asked good monitoring questions.
- Leadership: a bit light on cross-team influence examples.

Attachment: mina_scorecard_ari_ramsey.pdf

—Mina

Attached my scorecard. TL;DR: strong implementation chops (4), system-design tradeoffs convincing for moderate-scale workloads (3), but I flagged the database partitioning approach as brittle under heavy KV cache churn — would like to see follow-up on their migration/fallback plan.

If we proceed, recommend pairing with a senior engineer on the first project to validate their design assumptions. Not an outright no.

Attachment: david_scorecard_ari_ramsey.pdf

Appreciate the quick returns — below is a short aggregation to surface differences before we hand to Recruiting.

Aggregated (rubric averages):
- Technical: 3.7/5
- Product sense: 3.7/5
- Leadership: 3.5/5

Stances: Mina = soft no (leadership concern), David = green but flagged DB partitioning risk, Marissa = green with onboarding plan.

Proposal:
- We can move to reference checks and an initial offer (level: Senior) if Rishi and/or another PM-level approver OKs the leadership gap with a concrete 60-day onboarding plan.
- If anyone wants a short sync to hash out the partitioning risk, reply "sync" and I will set 20m tomorrow at 10am PT.

Action: please reply with one of the following by end of day tomorrow:
- "green" (proceed to references + offer)
- "green-with-onboarding" (proceed but require 60-day onboarding plan)
- "no" (do not proceed)

If no response, I will default to "green-with-onboarding" and ask Recruiting to start references.

—Olga
